about: Halftone Dossier house look (fixed; one house look per style, new components every reel). Ported from LemoLab's MIT-licensed style 'Halftone Dossier' (github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar, styles/halftone-dossier: STYLE.md, DEMO.md, demo/index.html) and adapted to a vertical talking head.
world: a talking-head reel read out as a retro print case file on its subject: paper pages (exhibits) alternate with the speaker's face as shot; the HUD and the caption bar run through both

palette._rule: the source's palette (DEMO.md 'Palette'): paper ground, ONE dark ink (navy: every outline, body text, the caption bar), pink = the overprint / misregistration shadow, yellow = highlight (keywords, numerals), red = stamps and alarms only, blue = halos and ink layers; orange only inside halftone numerals; no gradients, tone from dot size and overprint; dark pages = night ground + night2 dots

serif: headlines: black serif, 100-170 px, left on the margin x 80, misregistration shadow +0.055 em in pink (yellow or none on dark)
display: giant halftone numerals and exhibit numbers (the source's Bagel Fat One has no Cyrillic)
mono: HUD case number, date, chart ticks, typed evidence labels, plate sub-line (48 px)
sans: caption bar (54 px), stamps, plates, exhibit labels (the source's Noto Sans SC 900 role)

type.substitutions: Noto Serif SC 900 -> Playfair Display 900; Bagel Fat One -> Unbounded 900; Noto Sans SC 900 -> Inter 900; JetBrains Mono 800 kept; ZCOOL KuaiLe (interjections) not used. All OFL with Cyrillic, copied from templates/fonts.
type.caption: Inter 900 54 px cream on a navy pill (r 14, padding 20/34) with a pink 10/10 offset shadow, keyword words in yellow, centred on x 510, top y 1560 (bottom ~1690: 230 px clear for the Instagram UI); one line, <= 25 characters per chunk; pops in (0.4 s back.out, -2.4 deg -> -0.6 deg) on a new sentence and on every cut, hard swaps inside a sentence
type.never: Instrument Serif / Bagel Fat One / Noto SC (no Cyrillic); text under 48 px; SVG filter:url() (HyperFrames 0.8.159 blacks out other clips); boil on text, dots, HUD or captions; em dashes on screen

layout_px.hud: case number chip (mono 48) at x 60, y 130; chapter chip (Inter 900 48, yellow on navy) at y 214; REC dot + date chip right-aligned at x 980, y 130; inverts to cream chips on dark pages; hidden on the hook face world
layout_px.headline: baseline y 420-480 on pages (x 80, max width 900); behind the speaker's head on face worlds: baseline 60-80 px under the crown of the speaker's head so the head covers its lower part
layout_px.exhibit_zone: y 520-1500 on pages; the caption bar owns y 1560-1690

insert_frame.page: a <section> clip: flat ink ground, 1-3 halftone PNG layers (multiply), the exhibit, then paper.png multiplied over everything on the page, grain specks moved every 2 frames, a white flash layer
insert_frame.photo: a real picture the speaker names = a white-bordered print with a navy hard shadow and two yellow tape strips, dropping in rotated; never halftoned when it carries a face or a cover the speaker names
insert_frame.props: flat fill + 7 px navy outline, round joins; three jittered copies swap at 10 fps (line boil without SVG filters)
insert_frame.his_face: the plate as shot, full frame: no paper, no dots, no grain, no tint; only HUD, caption bar, behind-head headlines and a stamp below the speaker's face

motion.enter: everything enters with overshoot (back.out(1.9), 0.3-0.45 s), rising from below the frame or scaling from 0; nothing fades in
motion.glyph_pop: each headline glyph drops 0.45 em and squashes (scaleX 0.7 / scaleY 1.35 -> 1) with stagger 0.025-0.06 s
motion.stamp: opacity 0.3 at t-0.09, scale 2.6 -> 1 power3.in 0.09 s, opacity 0.93, elastic bounce 1.06 -> 1; page shake 16-22 px quadratic decay 0.35 s
motion.dot_wipe: 90 px grid, r 0 -> 66 (full cover) over 0.22 s with a 0.10 s diagonal delay, ink per cut; full on page-to-page cuts, only the page half on cuts that touch the speaker's face

sound.rule: the voice + SFX only, no music bed (the house rule); foley follows the print: a stamp = an impact on the frame it lands, a flash = a camera shutter, a page = a paper flip or a short whoosh at the cut, a prop landing = a pop, notifications = one notification ping; a little silence before the big stamp
sound.density: about 5-7 per 10 s (the source is dense foley over a score; without the score this keeps the print feel)
sound.volumes: 0.35-0.6; impacts 0.55-0.65; never louder than the voice

budgets.face: the speaker's face 40-55 % of the reel; no page longer than ~4.8 s; one idea per page
budgets.pages: 5-7 pages in 30 s, each an exhibit of the spoken line
budgets.stamps: 2-3 per 30 s, the last one closes the file

vary_per_reel: what the file is about (the subject of the reel) and its exhibits
the drawn props and their characters
the opening and the ending device
grade_rule: none: the speaker's footage stays as shot; no paper, dots, grain or tint on the speaker's face plate
components_rule: the house look is the palette, type, caption bar, HUD, paper + grain, halftone, stamp and wipe grammar; the exhibits (drawn props, cards, scenes), the stamp words, the hook and the ending are NEW every reel (catalog.json)
